scope: June, six enemies and three bosses, two poses each; no shadows.
palette_mode: Style-guide targets with the generated illustration's material and skin shading retained. These are illustrated Flow references, not restricted-palette runtime sprites.

entries.name: June from Legal
entries.alternate_pose: One hand resting on hip, the other raised palm outward in a gently skeptical 'hold that thought' gesture, same mature face.

entries.name: Bill
entries.alternate_pose: A determined running stride, paper corners fluttering, opposite arms swinging. Keep the broad red header stripe and exact face.

entries.name: 3 AM Thought
entries.alternate_pose: Lean into a different three-quarter floating drift, trailing small lavender puffs curl behind, one eyebrow raised. Crescent moon stays cream. No new limbs.

entries.name: Group Chat
entries.alternate_pose: Bouncing forward in a short waddling stride, tail and typing dots follow through, amused annoyed expression. No new objects.

entries.name: Calendar Invite
entries.alternate_pose: Charging three-quarter forward, one boot forward, arms counter-swing, one blank page curls outward, preserve header and rings.

entries.name: Spam Likely
entries.alternate_pose: Phone tilts into a ringing pose, arms spread, one boot lifted. Two restrained cream ringing arcs on either side. Keep exact screen symbols.

entries.name: Late-Night Donut
entries.alternate_pose: A jaunty running stride, one hand curled into a tiny fist, other arm back, same frosting and sprinkle arrangement, same mischievous expression.

entries.name: The Midlife Crisis
entries.alternate_pose: Same car turning into a playful drifting angle, front wheels steered, warm cream highlights on curved hood, no tire smoke or floor marks or added driver.

entries.name: The Performance Review
entries.alternate_pose: Same clipboard facing slightly left, elbows out and fists raised slightly, officious self-importance, planted feet. Keep the same face, chart and proportions.

entries.name: The 30-Year Mortgage
entries.alternate_pose: Stomping forward with one brown boot raised, paper stack flexes slightly, same house roof/shutters/face and abstract blank seal. No debris or floor.
